title: HoverPad v2.7.0 — Live Auto-Updater & Notification Center
notes: Added Live Over-the-Air (OTA) Auto-Updater synced directly with GitHub (JustNathan25/HoverPad).
Added Notification Center bell menu in the top bar for release notes, update progress, and workspace activity.
Cleaned up the note editor toolbar with a single-line layout and 3-dot note options popover menu.
Added full multi-breakpoint responsive layout across ultra-wide, desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
